# Summary

Land use change simulation results are based on the `r params$inputs$rep` iteration input and save as raster map (GeoTIFF) with the unique name `landscape{n-th}.tif`.

# Module brief description

- SCIENDO-Simulate predicts how land use will change in the future based on the training data that is done using SCIENDO-Train where land use/cover at T1 and T2, transition probability matrix and factor maps as explanatory variables like distance maps, climate variables, etc was taking into account.     

- Land use/cover change lookup table provides a comprehensive overview of how land use and land cover categories have transformed across all the projected years of a study

# Input data {.tabset}

## Land-Use/Cover Map Initial

```{r Land-Use/Cover Map T1, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_lc <- read.csv(params$inputs$lc_lookup_table_path)
#=Load landuse for two time periods
lc_t1 <- params$inputs$lc_t1_path %>% rast() %>%
  add_legend_to_categorical_raster(., lookup_table = df_lc)
plot_categorical_raster(lc_t1)
```

## Planning Unit

```{r planning unit, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
zone_rast <- rast(params$inputs$zone_path)

zone <- add_legend_to_categorical_raster(zone_rast, lookup_table = params$inputs$zone_lookup_table)

plot_categorical_raster(zone)
```

# Results

## Land Use/Cover Change Projection Maps {.tabset}

```{r lu projected maps, echo=FALSE, fig.keep='all', results='asis'}
list_luc <- params$inputs$output_dir %>% 
  list.files(full.names = TRUE, pattern = '^landscape\\d+\\.tif$')

lc_tbl_path <- params$inputs$lc_lookup_table_path
lc_tbl_ext  <- tolower(tools::file_ext(lc_tbl_path))
all_names   <- c('ID', 'Category', 'color_palette')

lc_table <- if (lc_tbl_ext %in% c('xlsx', 'xls')) {
  as.data.frame(openxlsx::read.xlsx(lc_tbl_path, startRow = 2, colNames = FALSE))
} else {
  as.data.frame(readr::read_csv(lc_tbl_path, skip = 1, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE))
}
names(lc_table) <- all_names[seq_len(ncol(lc_table))]

list_luc <- list_luc[order(as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(basename(list_luc), '\\d+')))]
rst_list <- list()

for(i in seq_along(list_luc)){
  file_path <- list_luc[i]
  r <- rast(file_path)
  rst_list[[file_path]] <- r
  year <- stringr::str_extract(basename(file_path), '\\d{4}')
  if(is.na(year)) year <- stringr::str_extract(basename(file_path), '\\d+')
  lyr_title <- paste0('Landscape ', year)

  cat(paste0('### Projected Land Cover in ', year, ' \n\n'))
  child_env <- new.env()
  child_env$r <- r
  child_env$lc_table <- lc_table
  child_env$year <- year
  child_env$plot_categorical_raster_mapview <- plot_categorical_raster_mapview

  cat(
  knitr::knit_child(
    text = c(
      '```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width="100%", out.height="500px"}',
      'plot_categorical_raster_mapview(r, lc_table, lyr_title)',
      '```'
    ),
    envir = child_env,
    quiet = TRUE
  ), sep = '\n'
  )
  cat('\n\n')
}
```

## Projected Land Use/Cover Change at the Landscape Level

```{r lut change, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Calculate freq table
lc_dir <- params$inputs$output_dir
init_yr <- if (!is.null(params$inputs$initial_year) && !is.na(params$inputs$initial_year) && nzchar(as.character(params$inputs$initial_year))) {
  as.character(params$inputs$initial_year)
} else {
  detected_yr <- stringr::str_extract(basename(params$inputs$lc_t1_path), "\\d{4}")
  if (!is.na(detected_yr) && nzchar(detected_yr)) detected_yr else "Initial"
}

lc_freq_table <- multiple_lc_freq_combined(
  lc_dir,
  df_lc,
  PU = "NO",
  initial_raster = lc_t1,
  initial_year = init_yr
)

# Export csv
ref_subset <- df_lc[, 1:2]
colnames(ref_subset) <- c("ID", "Landcover")

lc_freq_table_raw <- merge(ref_subset, lc_freq_table, by = "Landcover", all.y = TRUE)
proj_cols <- setdiff(names(lc_freq_table), "Landcover")
lc_freq_table_export <- lc_freq_table_raw[, c("ID", "Landcover", proj_cols)]
lc_freq_table_export <- lc_freq_table_export[order(lc_freq_table_export$ID), ]

write.table(lc_freq_table_export,
  paste0(params$inputs$output_dir, "/luc_projection.csv"),
  quote=FALSE,
  row.names=FALSE,
  sep=","
)
```

### Projected Land Use/Cover Area Chart
```{r Stacked Area Chart, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plot_interactive_stacked_area(lc_freq_table_export, cat_table = df_lc)
```

```{r Projected LULCC Table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

  DT::formatRound(columns = which(sapply(lc_freq_table, is.numeric)), digits = 1)
```

## Land Use/Cover Change Lookup Table at the Planning Unit Level {.tabset}

```{r child_document, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.keep='all', results='asis'}
all_freq_pu_list <- multiple_lc_freq_combined(lc_dir, df_lc, PU = "YES", zone = zone, split = "YES", initial_raster = lc_t1, initial_year = init_yr)
zone_df <- params$inputs$zone_lookup_table

# create expandable sections for each zone
src <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(zone_df)), function(i) {
  label <- zone_df$PU[[i]]
  
  knitr::knit_expand(text = c(
    "",
    "<details style='margin-bottom: 20px; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 5px; padding: 10px;'>",
    "<summary style='font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.1em; cursor: pointer; padding: 10px; background-color: #f8f9fa; border-radius: 3px; margin: -10px -10px 15px -10px;'>{{label}}</summary>",
    "",
    "```{r zone_{{i}}_table, echo=FALSE}",
    "lc_proj_table <- all_freq_pu_list[[{{i}}]]",
    "if (nrow(lc_proj_table) > 0) {",
    "  year_columns <- colnames(lc_proj_table)[-1]",
    "  ",
    "  if (length(year_columns) > 0) {",
    "    years_text <- paste('for years', paste(year_columns, collapse = ', '))",
    "  } else {",
    "    years_text <- ''",
    "  }",
    "  ",
    "  DT::datatable(",
    "    lc_proj_table,",
    "    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(",
    "      style = 'caption-side: top; text-align: center; color:black; font-size:1.2em;',",
    "      paste('Projected Land Use/Cover in {{label}}', years_text)",
    "    ),", 
    "    rownames = FALSE,",
    "    options = list(",
    "      dom = 't',",
    "      pageLength = nrow(lc_proj_table),",
    "      autoWidth = FALSE,",
    "      scrollX = TRUE,",
    "      columnDefs = list(list(width = '100%', targets = '_all'))",
    "    )",
    "  ) %>%",
    "  DT::formatRound(columns = which(sapply(lc_proj_table, is.numeric)), digits = 1)",
    "} else {",
    "  cat('<div style=\"text-align: center; margin: 20px; color: #666;\">No data available for this zone.</div>')",
    "}",
    "```",
    "",
    "</details>",
    ""
  ), i = i, label = label)
})

res <- knitr::knit_child(text = unlist(src), quiet = TRUE)
cat(res, sep = '\n')
```
